registered_question: Does the v13 sparse dictionary, fitted on native DomainNet, retain its coding value on a corpus it never saw - and how much of any loss is resolution rather than corpus?
registration_notes: N85.8 - the operand is retention, not accuracy. A 128-way DomainNet number and a 20-way CIFAR-100 number are not comparable, and R7 forbids exactly this kind of cross-corpus reading. What transfers or fails to transfer is the dictionary's value relative to the raw features it codes, so every cell reports sparse-probe accuracy divided by dense-probe accuracy on the identical rows, the identical split and the identical training budget. Absolute accuracies are reported too, and are never compared across arms.

N85.9 - width is matched rather than assumed away. DomainNet is read at its full 128 classes and again at labels 0-19, fixed positionally with no selection, so that the CIFAR-100 cell has a same-width partner. CIFAR-100 is read at the matched 32/32 per-class budget and again at its full 250/250, because reporting only the budget that flatters would be the R4 defect in a new place.

N85.2 - the degraded arm is the whole point. It is the corpus's own held-out evaluation rows, the identical images, at CIFAR-100's 32x32 resolution through the identical frozen graph. A retention drop on CIFAR-100 that also appears on degraded DomainNet is a statement about low-resolution input, not about corpus transfer.

N85.10 - R5 nulls. Every cell carries a label-shuffled null sharing its structure, budget and split, and the dictionary carries M80's registered random-dictionary null. A cell is reported with its nulls or not at all. The free-composability bar is k-NN on the raw features of the same split.

partition.rationale: N83.7's split. The dictionary is fitted on the fit rows only, so every arm below is read on rows the dictionary never saw.

dictionary.rationale: M80's registered cell, carried unchanged under N80.2. The dictionary seed is the run seed, so the three seeds vary the learned basis and not only the head.

probe.rationale: M81's probe budget, identical for the sparse and dense arms so that the ratio in N85.8 is a statement about the representation rather than about the optimiser.

reporting.rationale: Retention is recorded as differing between two arms only if the gap exceeds this margin, which is wider than the observed spread across seeds. Anything inside it is a tie.
